scripts.dev: BLINK_AUTH_MODE=switcher concurrently -n web,worker "next dev" "tsx watch scripts/worker.ts"
scripts.demo: BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay pnpm build && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay BLINK_AUTH_MODE=switcher BLINK_ALLOW_SWITCHER=1 concurrently -n web,worker "next start" "tsx scripts/worker.ts"
scripts.db:reset: rm -f data/blink.db data/blink.db-wal data/blink.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet
scripts.db:reset:dev: rm -f data/blink.db data/blink.db-wal data/blink.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts --manual-policy --gold && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet
scripts.e2e:serve:live: BLINK_DB_PATH=./data/e2e-live.db BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay BLINK_AUTH_MODE=switcher BLINK_ALLOW_SWITCHER=1 BLINK_ALLOW_SCRIPTED_CALLS=1 sh -c 'rm -f data/e2e-live.db data/e2e-live.db-wal data/e2e-live.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts --manual-policy && next build && concurrently -k -n web,worker "next start -p 3101" "tsx scripts/worker.ts"'
scripts.e2e:serve: BLINK_DB_PATH=./data/e2e.db BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay BLINK_AUTH_MODE=switcher BLINK_ALLOW_SWITCHER=1 sh -c 'rm -f data/e2e.db data/e2e.db-wal data/e2e.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet && next build && concurrently -k -n web,worker "next start -p 3100" "tsx scripts/worker.ts"'
